guardrails: Primary dispatch tickets become stale before they become ineligible.
A primary ticket cannot be work-stolen before its hard expiry.
Work stealing creates bounded generated standby tickets and never auto-claims work.
V11 one-active-claim-per-worker and one-active-claim-per-slot rules remain authoritative.
Work-steal claims do not train the V13 primary-routing learner.
Unknown legacy ticket age is never guessed.
A backup worker must satisfy the configured minimum routing-score ratio.
Dispatch tickets never authorize external actions beyond the bounded hunt assignment.
